Definition
[Wedge sum]

\group Homotopy Theory For pointed spaces $(X,x_0)$ and $(Y,y_0)$, the wedge sum $X\vee Y$ is $(X\sqcup Y)/(x_0\sim y_0)$. An arbitrary wedge of CW complexes is a CW complex when every chosen basepoint is a $0$-cell. Moreover, $X^n/X^{n-1}$ is the wedge of one $S^n$ for each $n$-cell.
